content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script that imports measured gauge variables from A.mat and numerical station tables from sta_0002 through sta_0004 (lines 25-29), scales/aligns their time and surface-elevation columns (lines 31-40), and draws three measured-versus-simulation subplots for gauges 5, 7, and 9 (lines 42-76).
entities: A.mat workspace variables t, g5, g7, and g9 expected after load @L26
unresolved: Use-before-local-assignment / implicit interface: t, g5, g7, and g9 are referenced on lines 34, 45, 57, and 68 without declarations or assignments in the script; they must be injected by load('A.mat') on line 26, so missing fields, shapes, and units are unchecked.
The header contradicts itself: lines 16-17 describe first column as time, while lines 20-21 describe it as location; the code treats every station first column as time on lines 35, 37, and 39.

The header says two gauge files/locations g7 and g9 on lines 13-14, but the implementation loads three station files on lines 27-29 and plots gauges 5, 7, and 9 on lines 44-70, indicating stale or copied interface documentation.
Each plot assumes matched vector lengths within its pair (t with g5/g7/g9; tn1/tn2/tn3 with g5n/g7n/g9n), and station indexing assumes at least two columns; no validation is performed.
The numerical time coordinate is divided by scaleT on lines 35, 37, and 39 while the measured time is only shifted on line 34; the source units justifying this asymmetric conversion are not stated.
